title: BusinessEvent
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — event classification for data flowing through Interactions. A business event signals that something of governance relevance has occurred. Used as the data Archetype for Effectors and Receptors (archetype field). Rootless — not a Structure, Mechanism, or Interaction; it types the payload exchanged between them. Source framework: TOGAF (Content Metamodel → Business Event).

eventType.description: Event classification. DOMAIN = business state change, INTEGRATION = system boundary crossing, LIFECYCLE = entity lifecycle transition, COMMAND = action request, NOTIFICATION = informational broadcast. TOGAF mapping: Business Event type.

triggerMode.description: How the event is triggered. TOGAF mapping: Event trigger mechanism.
